data.title: 星熊 · 般若盾牌旁的大碗喝酒
data.action: 单腿踩在矮凳上，一手端着大口海碗畅饮清酒，头顶鬼角在灯下闪亮，豪爽洒脱地大笑着拍你的肩膀
data.location: 龙门近卫局特别督察官私人宿所低矮木几旁
data.lighting: 室内酒肆风味浓郁的红灯笼暖黄光晕，在墨黑真丝麻织大睡袍与高大健硕的体魄上投下豪迈阴影
data.camera: low angle, three quarter view, cowboy shot
data.mood: 豪迈不羁、肝胆相照、千杯不醉的江湖大姐头
data.description: 龙门街头警务结束后的深夜。近卫局特别督察组的星熊脱下重装警服，换上一件宽松霸气的墨黑丝麻开襟长睡袍，衣襟前敞展露出紧实强健的腹肌线条。著名的重装巨盾‘般若’静静靠在墙角。星熊单腿踩着矮木凳，手里端着粗陶海碗满饮烈酒，头顶独角在红灯笼下熠熠生辉。看见走近的陈或博士，她发出爽朗豪迈的大笑，大手一把揽过你的肩膀——「哈哈哈！今天龙门下水道的那窝暴徒总算全逮住了！来，别拘束！今晚这坛上好的烈酒管够，不喝到天亮谁都不准回去睡！」
data.promptProse: Hoshiguma unwinds late at night inside her Lungmen quarters, wearing an open-front ink-black silk-linen lounging robe with wide sleeves and a thick rope tie over her tall, athletic frame. With one bare foot propped on a low wooden stool and her Hannya shield resting against the wall, she raises a wide ceramic sake bowl in a hearty laugh under warm red lantern light.
data.animaCaption: Planting one bare foot on a low wooden stool in a loose open-front black silk-linen robe, she raises a wide ceramic bowl of sake with a booming, open-hearted laugh as her Hannya shield rests in the corner. Warm red lantern light highlights her tall, athletic frame.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a loose open-collar ink-black silk-linen lounging robe with wide raglan sleeves and a thick rope tie, parted casually at the front over her toned waist.
